prototype.en: The engineering club tested a prototype before building the final model.
prototype.zh: 工程社在製作最終模型前先測試原型。

proud.en: She felt proud after finishing the project through steady effort.
proud.zh: 她靠持續努力完成專題後感到自豪。

proverb.en: The teacher used a proverb to begin a discussion about patience.
proverb.zh: 老師用一句諺語開啟關於耐心的討論。

provide.en: The library can provide quiet rooms for students working in groups.
provide.zh: 圖書館能提供安靜房間給小組合作的學生。

province.en: The map shows each province and its major cities clearly.
province.zh: 地圖清楚標示每個省份及其主要城市。

provincial.en: The museum preserves records from the former provincial administration.
provincial.zh: 博物館保存過去省級行政機關的紀錄。

provision.en: The agreement includes a provision for reviewing the plan each year.
provision.zh: 這份協議包含每年檢討計畫的條款。

provisional.en: The committee published a provisional schedule before confirming every speaker.
provisional.zh: 委員會在確認所有講者前公布暫定時程。

provoke.en: The surprising result may provoke further questions from the research team.
provoke.zh: 這項意外結果可能引發研究團隊更多問題。

publicity.en: The event received more publicity after local newspapers reported it.
publicity.zh: 地方報紙報導後，活動獲得更多曝光。

publicize.en: The school will publicize the contest through its website and newsletter.
publicize.zh: 學校將透過網站與電子報宣傳比賽。

publisher.en: The publisher released a revised edition of the reference book.
publisher.zh: 出版社推出這本參考書的修訂版。

pudding.en: The cafeteria served fruit pudding as a small dessert after lunch.
pudding.zh: 學校餐廳午餐後提供水果布丁作為小甜點。

puff.en: A small puff of steam rose from the warm cup.
puff.zh: 一小股蒸氣從溫熱的杯子上升起。

pull.en: Please pull the door gently because the handle is loose.
pull.zh: 門把有點鬆，請輕輕拉門。

pulse.en: The science activity used a sensor to measure a steady pulse.
pulse.zh: 科學活動用感測器測量穩定的脈搏。

pump.en: A small pump moves water through the classroom aquarium filter.
pump.zh: 一個小幫浦讓水流經教室水族箱的過濾器。

pumpkin.en: The garden produced one large pumpkin near the end of summer.
pumpkin.zh: 花園在夏末長出一顆大南瓜。

punctual.en: Being punctual helps group meetings begin without unnecessary delays.
punctual.zh: 準時能讓小組會議避免不必要的延誤。

puppet.en: The drama club used a puppet to tell a traditional story.
puppet.zh: 戲劇社用布偶講述一個傳統故事。

puppy.en: The puppy slept beside its water bowl after playing outside.
puppy.zh: 小狗在戶外玩耍後睡在水碗旁。

pure.en: The experiment requires pure water so other substances do not interfere.
pure.zh: 實驗需要純水，以免其他物質造成干擾。

purify.en: Wetland plants can help purify water naturally in some environments.
purify.zh: 在某些環境中，濕地植物能自然幫助淨化水質。

purity.en: The lab checked the purity of the water sample carefully.
purity.zh: 實驗室仔細檢查水樣的純度。

purple.en: A purple flower grew beside the path after the spring rain.
purple.zh: 春雨後，小徑旁長出一朵紫色花。

purse.en: She found her bus card inside a small purse.
purse.zh: 她在小錢包裡找到公車卡。

pursuit.en: Curiosity can motivate the pursuit of knowledge across many subjects.
pursuit.zh: 好奇心能促使人們在各領域追求知識。

push.en: Please push the cart slowly through the narrow hallway.
push.zh: 請慢慢推著推車通過狹窄走廊。

put.en: Please put the finished worksheet in the tray by the door.
put.zh: 請把完成的學習單放進門邊的托盤。

puzzle.en: The logic puzzle took our group nearly twenty minutes to solve.
puzzle.zh: 這道邏輯謎題讓我們小組花了將近二十分鐘解開。

pyramid.en: The history book includes a diagram of an ancient pyramid.
pyramid.zh: 歷史課本收錄一張古代金字塔的圖解。

quake.en: The sudden quake caused books to fall from several shelves.
quake.zh: 突如其來的地震讓幾個書架上的書掉落。

qualification.en: The program lists each qualification required for new applicants.
qualification.zh: 這項計畫列出新申請者需要具備的各項資格。

quarrel.en: A small quarrel ended after both students explained their views calmly.
quarrel.zh: 兩位學生冷靜說明看法後，小爭執就結束了。

quarter.en: Only a quarter of the class chose the optional afternoon activity.
quarter.zh: 全班只有四分之一選擇下午的自由活動。

queen.en: The museum displayed a letter written during the queen's reign.
queen.zh: 博物館展示一封在女王統治期間寫的信。

quest.en: The novel follows a student's quest to uncover a family mystery.
quest.zh: 小說描述一名學生尋找家族謎團答案的旅程。

questionnaire.en: Each participant completed a short questionnaire after the workshop.
questionnaire.zh: 每位參與者在工作坊後填寫一份簡短問卷。

quilt.en: The handmade quilt displayed many patterns from different local traditions.
quilt.zh: 這條手工被子展示不同地方傳統的多種圖案。

quit.en: He decided to quit the club because his schedule became too busy.
quit.zh: 他因行程變得太忙而決定退出社團。

quiver.en: The thin leaves quiver whenever a strong breeze passes through.
quiver.zh: 強風吹過時，細薄的葉子就會顫動。

quiz.en: Our teacher gave a short quiz at the end of class.
quiz.zh: 老師在下課前出了一個小測驗。

quota.en: The program reached its enrollment quota earlier than expected this year.
quota.zh: 這項計畫今年比預期更早達到招生名額。

quotation.en: The essay begins with a short quotation from a historical speech.
quotation.zh: 這篇文章以一段歷史演說的短引文開頭。

quote.en: Please quote only the sentence that directly supports your argument.
quote.zh: 請只引用能直接支持你論點的句子。

rabbit.en: A rabbit appeared beside the trail early in the morning.
rabbit.zh: 清晨時，一隻兔子出現在步道旁。

rack.en: The bicycles were parked neatly in a rack beside the station.
rack.zh: 自行車整齊停在車站旁的停車架。

radar.en: Weather radar showed a band of heavy rain approaching the coast.
radar.zh: 氣象雷達顯示一帶大雨正接近海岸。

radiant.en: The radiant morning light filled the classroom through the large windows.
radiant.zh: 明亮的晨光透過大窗戶灑滿教室。

radish.en: The class planted radish seeds in the school garden this spring.
radish.zh: 班上今年春天在校園花園種下蘿蔔種子。
